description: Every supplier ACTIVE and every lane NORMAL. It has no scenario_state rows because it changes nothing.
A grounded vessel blocks the canal; every lane routed through Suez is unavailable.
A plant fire takes supplier S007 (Istanbul, Turkey) offline; no route is affected.
A cyclone makes landfall at Mumbai and closes the port; the Mumbai lane is unavailable, and supplier S003, which ships through it, is stranded.
A sharp rise in tariffs on imports from Turkey; raises the landed cost of Turkish suppliers and blocks nothing.
A berth bottleneck at Rotterdam delays every inbound lane.
An unexpected jump in demand outstrips the warehouses' buffers.
Shipping avoids the Red Sea: every lane through Bab-el-Mandeb is unavailable and the Cape lanes are the way round. A prolonged stress test, not a claim about any real event.
